05.
1.

This is the second application of the petitioner under Section 439 Cr.P.C. in connection with Dharambandha P.S. Case No.20 of 2019 corresponding to C.T. Case No.180 of 2019, pending in the file of the learned S.D.J.M., Nuapada where the petitioner and co-accused persons are facing trial for commission of offences punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468 of IPC.

2. BLAPL No.12963 of 2023 filed earlier by the petitioner had been rejected on 17.11.2023 as the petitioner could not be arrested for a period of three years but liberty had been granted to him to move for bail afresh after completion of investigation.

Thereafter, his prayer for bail had been rejected on 11.12.2023 by the learned Addl. District and Sessions Judge, Nuapada in BLAPL No.130/64 of 2023.
3.

The prosecution allegation in brief against the petitioner is that petitioner who is the manager of SKS Bharat Finance alongwith co- accused, Rakesh Pandey, Taturam Pandey, Thanu Pandey,
Kausik Pandey, Rajesh Pandey and Ramesh Harijan had diverted the loan amount of the five informants, namely, Heja Majhi, wife of Lalsingh Majhi, Amrutan Majhi, wife of Ghanashyam Majhi, Dileswari Rout, wife of Nico Rout, Santosi Tandi, wife of Sibacharan Tandi and Chita Harijan, wife of Sataram Harijan and seventeen others by forging their passbook accounts.

4. Mr. Umakanta Barik, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the co-accused persons,
namely, Rakesh Pandey, Taturam Pandey, Rajesh Pandey, Ramesh Harijan and Thanu @ Thanuram Pandey have been directed to be released on bail on their surrendering by order dated 03.01.2020 Maniram Mahanand vs State Of Odisha ...

He further submits that trial has started in the case and four informants and husband of one of the informant have been examined in the trial as P.Ws. 1 to 6 and he has filed the copies of the depositions where they have stated that the disputes have been settled with the accused persons and the money which was allegedly borrowed in the name of the informants has been received by them.
He further submits that the petitioner is in custody since 26.09.2023.
5. Mr.S.S.Mohapatra, learned Addl.

Standing Counsel opposes the prayer for bail stating that the petitioner was a Manager in Bharat Finance Company Ltd. and he is the master mind who was facilitated the grant of second loan to the informants and other villagers (seventeen in number) and thereafter diverted the sanctioned loan amount to another account and withdrawn the same.

He further submits that only six persons have been examined in the trial and even if the informants stated that the money sanctioned to them has been received by them, the total loan amount which has been diverted by the petitioner has not yet been recovered.
He further submits that the petitioner may tamper with evidence and influence the prosecution witnesses if he is released on bail.
He also submits that since the petitioner had absconded for three years, trial will get stalled, as he may abscond.

6. Considering the nature of allegations against the petitioner, the period spent by him in custody and as co-accused persons against whom similar allegations have been made have been released on bail, I am inclined to allow the prayer for bail, but subject to stringent conditions, so that trial is not affected.

7. Let the petitioner- Maniram Mahanand be released on bail on such terms and conditions as may be fixed by the learned Court below in seisin over the matter, including the following conditions:
(i) He will not indulge in any criminal activity while on bail.
(ii) He will not threaten or try to influence prosecution witnesses while on bail.
(iii) He will report before the IIC, Dharambandha P.S. once in a week, preferably on a Sunday between 4.00 P.M. to 6.00 P.M. till completion of investigation.
(iv) He will remain present in the trial Court on each date it if fixed for trial.
(v) He will not leave Kalahandi District without prior permission of the learned trial Court.
8. Violation of any condition will entail in cancellation of bail.
9. The BLAPL is accordingly allowed.
10. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted on proper application.
